description:
## Objective

Create one enforced layout for all supported examples.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U8`
Covers: `R1, R2, R3, R4; KTD1, KTD3, KTD5, KTD6.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.2 (U2) — Activate authoring and Covenant gates must be complete; jido-07x.5 (U5) — Port Action and Flow property checks must be complete; jido-07x.24 (U24) — Generate and enforce the quality report must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.9 (U9) — Port Action compilation examples must be complete; jido-07x.10 (U10) — Port Action execution examples must be complete; jido-07x.11 (U11) — Port advanced Action examples must be complete; jido-07x.12 (U12) — Port core basic and workflow examples must be complete; jido-07x.13 (U13) — Port core runtime and topology examples must be complete; jido-07x.14 (U14) — Port core Plugin and persistence examples must be complete; jido-07x.15 (U15) — Port offline AI examples must be complete.

## Files

Add `examples/README.md`, `test/examples/README.md`, `test/examples/catalog_test.exs`, and shared `test/examples/support/**`. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Define one stable example ID format and category register.
2. Require one README, one primary source, and one paired test for every supported example.
3. Make the catalog test reject missing files, duplicate IDs, and unlisted examples.
4. Load example source only when example paths or the `:example` tag are selected.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An orphan README, source, or test makes the catalog test fail.
- [ ] Default `mix test` does not compile the example tree.
- [ ] `mix test.examples` is offline and uses seed `0`.

## Verification

- `mix test test/examples/catalog_test.exs --include example --seed 0` exits with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

comments.text: Implemented the unified example catalog harness on main. Added examples/README.md, test/examples/README.md, catalog.yml, catalog and loader support, catalog tests, the support ignore filter, and three ported manifest records. The catalog enforces stable slash IDs, registered categories, one README, one primary source, one paired test, unique assets, complete inventory, the :example tag, and setup_all loader use. The existing live-provider example is an explicit temporary exclusion for U15/U19. Verified catalog tests (7 passed), mix test.examples (7 passed), default selection (7 excluded), manifest tests (6 passed), compile warnings, formatting, and diff checks. Commit: 55c814d. Deferred assets: existing U9-U15 source groups remain deferred. Deviations: none. Remaining blockers: U9-U15 must register each ported example.

Follow-up in 545eee2: the catalog now enforces category/NN_NN_lesson IDs, NN_chapter/NN_NN_lesson source and test paths, matching chapter prefixes, mirrored paths, sorted IDs, and intentional gaps. Catalog verification: 8 passed. Full offline examples: 35 passed.
